recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7772 unless FM later approves a new issue changing Coverage.subscriber target profiles.
issue_request: FHIR-7772 was a Published FHIR-core Coverage change request asking that Coverage.subscriber support a non-patient person. FM resolved it as Persuasive with Modification: Person could not be used because it is an indexing resource, but RelatedPerson should be added.
initial_application: Git commit 43806174288e821cb06173a72cde96317186412b explicitly listed tracker 7772 and added Coverage.subscriber with type Reference(Patient|RelatedPerson) in the then-authoritative Coverage spreadsheet source. Later refactors moved the definition to source/coverage/structuredefinition-Coverage.xml while preserving Patient and RelatedPerson.
additional_context: Coverage is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-14382 later recorded that a subscriber may be Patient or RelatedPerson, and FHIR-40365 later rejected removing RelatedPerson because some jurisdictions need it. Community searches found no direct conflicting FHIR-7772 or FHIR-40365 record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Coverage StructureDefinition already defines Coverage.subscriber as a Reference targeting Patient and RelatedPerson, matching the final Jira resolution.

related_jiras.note: FM rejected a later request to remove RelatedPerson from Coverage.subscriber, supporting the current target profile set.
